title: DelayOPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation from a Synchronous Teacher for Real-time Asynchronous Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.30534v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies incur substantial inference latency due to their large vision-language backbones and iterative denoising. Asynchronous execution reduces this latency by generating the next action chunk while executing the current one, but the new chunk is conditioned on a stale observation, degrading performance as the delay increases. We investigate this mismatch by comparing actions predicted from observations at planning and execution times. We find that these predictions differ little on expert demonstrations but diverge substantially on the policy's own delayed rollouts, particularly in failed episodes. Motivated by this observation, we propose DelayOPSD, which trains an asynchronous policy to imitate its synchronous counterpart on the policy's own rollouts. translated_title: DelayOPSD：基于同步教师模型的在线自蒸馏，实现实时异步策略
translated_abstract: 基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略由于其庞大的视觉-语言骨干网络和迭代去噪过程而存在显著的推理延迟。异步执行通过在执行当前动作块的同时生成下一个动作块来减少这种延迟，但新生成的动作块是以过时的观测为条件的，随着延迟的增加，性能会随之下降。我们通过比较在规划时刻和执行时刻基于观测所预测的动作来研究这种不匹配问题。我们发现，这些预测在专家演示数据上差异很小，但在策略自身延迟执行的 rollout 上却差异很大，尤其是在失败的回合中。受这一观察的启发，我们提出 DelayOPSD，该方法训练异步策略在策略自身的 rollout 上模仿其同步对应策略。具体而言，利用执行时刻的观测从同一策略中获得的同步教师模型，来监督延迟的学生策略（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出DelayOPSD方法，通过在线自蒸馏让异步延迟策略在自身rollout上模仿使用执行时刻最新观测的同步教师策略，从而解决异步执行中因观测过时导致的性能下降问题。
